hooks.name: pre-commit
hooks.script:
#!/bin/sh
# VibeForge pre-commit hook. Skip once with: git commit --no-verify
set -e
staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM)
[ -z "$staged" ] && exit 0
fail=0
IFS='
'

# 1. Secrets files and keys
for f in $staged; do
  case "$f" in
    *.example|*.sample|*.template) ;;
    .env|.env.*|*/.env|*/.env.*|*.pem|*.key|*id_rsa*|*.p12|*.keystore|*.jks)
      echo "✋ $f looks like a secrets file. Unstage it: git rm --cached \"$f\""; fail=1 ;;
  esac
done
for f in $staged; do
  case "$f" in .githooks/*) continue ;; esac
  if git diff --cached -U0 -- "$f" | grep -E '^\+' | grep -Eq '(AKIA|ASIA)[0-9A-Z]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}|[rs]k_live_[0-9A-Za-z]{16,}|xox[abprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}|LLM[_|][0-9]{8,}[_|][A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----'; then
    echo "✋ $f has a key or token in it. Move it to .env (ignored) and read it from the environment."
    fail=1
  fi
done

# 2. Large files
limit=$((5 * 1024 * 1024))
for f in $staged; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  size=$(wc -c < "$f" | tr -d ' ')
  if [ "$size" -gt "$limit" ]; then
    echo "✋ $f is $((size / 1024 / 1024)) MB (limit 5 MB). Add it to .gitignore or use Git LFS."; fail=1
  fi
done

[ "$fail" -eq 0 ] || { echo "Commit stopped by VibeForge hooks."; exit 1; }
hooks.title: Before every commit
why: Stops .env files, private keys and token-looking strings before they are committed.
Stops files over 5 MB (videos, builds, databases) that make the repo slow forever.

setup_script:
#!/bin/sh
# VibeForge Git setup. Run it from your project folder: sh vibeforge-git-setup.sh
set -e

[ -d .git ] || git init -b 'main'
grep -qx 'vibeforge-git-setup.sh' .git/info/exclude 2>/dev/null || echo 'vibeforge-git-setup.sh' >> .git/info/exclude
git config user.name 'Ada Lovelace'
git config user.email 'ada@example.com'

# .gitignore
cat > .gitignore <<'VIBEFORGE_EOF'
# Secrets never go in Git
.env
.env.*
!.env.example
*.pem
*.key

# OS and editor clutter
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db
.idea/
.vscode/*
!.vscode/extensions.json

# Logs
*.log

# Suggested by Meta Muse for this project
# Dependencies
node_modules/

# Build output - React frontend and server build
build/
dist/

# Test output and caches
coverage/
.eslintcache
.cache/
VIBEFORGE_EOF

# Hooks live in .githooks so the whole team shares them
mkdir -p .githooks
cat > .githooks/pre-commit <<'VIBEFORGE_EOF'

# VibeForge pre-commit hook. Skip once with: git commit --no-verify

  esac
done
for f in $staged; do

    echo "✋ $f has a key or token in it. Move it to .env (ignored) and read it from the environment."
    fail=1
  fi
done

# 2. Large files
limit=$((5 * 1024 * 1024))
for f in $staged; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  size=$(wc -c < "$f" | tr -d ' ')
  if [ "$size" -gt "$limit" ]; then
    echo "✋ $f is $((size / 1024 / 1024)) MB (limit 5 MB). Add it to .gitignore or use Git LFS."; fail=1
  fi
done

[ "$fail" -eq 0 ] || { echo "Commit stopped by VibeForge hooks."; exit 1; }
VIBEFORGE_EOF
chmod +x .githooks/pre-commit
git config core.hooksPath .githooks

# Stop tracking files the new .gitignore covers (they stay on disk)
git rm -r --cached --quiet --ignore-unmatch . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || git remote add origin 'https://github.com/ada-builds/recipe-box.git'

git add -A
if git commit -q -m "chore: set up git with VibeForge"; then
  echo "✓ Git is set up. Push with: git push -u origin HEAD"
else
  echo "Git is set up, but the hooks stopped the first commit. Fix what they list above, then run: git commit -m 'chore: first commit'"
fi
